query:
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(postingDate, '%Y-%m') as competenceMonth,
  SUM(totalAmount) as totalCompras,
  COUNT(*) as qtd
FROM purchaseOrders
WHERE status = 'RECEIVED'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(postingDate, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY competenceMonth DESC
LIMIT 10;
